payload.reason: The evidence provides a detailed explanation of how the BERT-based model works for extractive query-focused summarization, including input representation and processing steps.

claims.text: The BERT-based model encodes query relevance, document context, and salient meanings into vector representations using BERT.
The model takes the concatenation of the query and document as input and uses a self-attention mechanism to model relationships.
Input representations are constructed by summing token, segmentation, and position embeddings, with special tokens indicating boundaries.
